encryption_posture_summary:
High-level summary (customer-facing):

- In-transit: mutual TLS mandatory between customer VPC endpoints and Redwood data-plane. We recommend TLS 1.3 with ECDHE key exchange and cert pinning for control-plane to data-plane channels. Option for AWS PrivateLink or Azure Private Endpoint to avoid public Internet; PrivateLink demonstrator included in PoC.

- mTLS details: customer provides x.509 certs or we can rotate certs via ACME internally; support for custom CA chains. Session-level auth uses client cert + session token for defense in depth.

- At-rest: all customer model inputs/outputs and cached KV shards encrypted using envelope encryption. Root DEK protected by customer-managed CMK (BYOK) in supported KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS). We support HSM-backed keys (KMIP/HSM) where required.

- Key lifecycle & rotation: Redwood supports automated envelope-key rotation and can trigger rewrap operations on customer schedule. Customer retains full control of CMK and can rotate or disable keys; PoC will verify rotation without data loss. Rotation policy examples: monthly rotation for data keys, annual rotation for CMK.

- Secrets management: secrets (service credentials, DB passwords) are stored in the customer's vault (HashiCorp Vault recommended) and mounted to Redwood agents via short-lived tokens. No long-lived provider secrets stored by Redwood in Private control-plane deployments. Support for Vault transit for signing and encryption operations.

- Audit logging & tamper-evidence: all key usage and KMS API calls are logged to the customer's cloud audit service (CloudTrail / Azure Monitor) and optionally forwarded to SIEM (Splunk/Datadog). PoC will include sample audit exports and a retention policy (configurable).

- Data residency: customer data caches and persistent store remain in the customer's chosen region. Snapshots exported for debug only with explicit consent; default is disabled.

- Compliance notes: process aligns with SOC2 controls for encryption-in-transit and at-rest. For high-assurance customers we offer HSM-backed BYOK and on-prem control-plane options.

- Edge cases & constraints: inter-region fallback requires explicit consent; if CMK disabled, fallback path uses a separate provider-locked key (audit-only) — customer requested this be disabled for production.

- PoC asks: provide sample KMS key ARN(s), Vault role ID + secret ID for temporary test, confirm preferred PrivateLink vs Peering, list of allowed CIDR blocks for peering, and SOC2 attestation copy.
